hits.text: claims-events design (synthetic). Claim events are published to the claims-events Kafka topic, partitioned by policy number so events for one policy stay in order. A consumer retries a failed event three times with backoff, then moves it to claims-events.DLQ. The payments consumer is idempotent: it records claim_event_id in the processed_events table and skips duplicates, so a redelivered message never pays a claim twice. The Kafka platform is run by StreamOps (vendor); support channel #streamops-support.

Open questions: ['Why is the retry limit three and not five?'] Expert answers: The retry limit is three because three retries with backoff fit inside the 30-second consumer timeout agreed with StreamOps; five retries caused duplicate-processing alerts.
